comparison_registry.project_finding: HE2 internal historical retrieval advantage over three corrected normative arms on five primary HE2_A metrics
comparison_registry.compatibility_justification: External tasks, datasets, HS levels, metrics, denominators and protocols are heterogeneous.
comparison_registry.interpretation_boundary: Internal frozen-benchmark result only; no cross-study numerical superiority.

comparison_registry.project_finding: Historical ranking followed by normative evidence and controlled explanation of a fixed Top-3
comparison_registry.compatibility_justification: Systems share RAG or evidence components but assign different decision roles to rules, evidence and LLMs.
comparison_registry.interpretation_boundary: Architectural distinction, not performance or novelty evidence.

comparison_registry.project_finding: The local LLM cannot introduce or reorder codes
comparison_registry.compatibility_justification: Related systems expose agentic, hierarchical or constraint-aware components, while decision contracts differ.
comparison_registry.interpretation_boundary: Functional contract only; no automatic superiority.

comparison_registry.project_finding: Explicit separation of ranking performance, documentary evidence and controlled explanation
comparison_registry.compatibility_justification: Evidence, rationale, citations and faithfulness appear in related work but do not share a formal output-auditability evaluation contract.
comparison_registry.interpretation_boundary: No classification validation or legal correctness follows.

comparison_registry.compatibility_justification: Shared provenance and traceability concepts have different units and assurance targets.
comparison_registry.interpretation_boundary: Provenance does not certify correctness or legal sufficiency.

comparison_registry.compatibility_justification: The frozen source governs authority, currency and traceability rather than a comparable ranking-performance task.
comparison_registry.interpretation_boundary: Official source, normative association and document retrieval do not establish legal sufficiency or correct classification.

comparison_registry.compatibility_justification: The frozen literature does not establish an equivalent observation-group structure or split protocol.
comparison_registry.interpretation_boundary: Missing documentation is not evidence of leakage.

comparison_registry.compatibility_justification: No frozen source provides an aligned design that isolates the same estimand.

comparison_registry.project_finding: EXP11B descriptive H150/H200 results across ten observed seed pairs
comparison_registry.compatibility_justification: No aligned seed-sampling population or inference protocol is available.
The frozen source governs the same internal corrective chain but not an external performance benchmark.
comparison_registry.interpretation_boundary: Not global zero impact; no causality or uncomputed significance.

comparison_registry.project_finding: EXP12 closed without retrieval and diversity effect not estimable
comparison_registry.compatibility_justification: The frozen corpus contains no conceptually aligned feasibility design.
comparison_registry.interpretation_boundary: No global infeasibility and no evidence for or against HE5.

authorized_discussion_points.allowed_statement: El retrieval historico obtuvo mejor rendimiento interno que los brazos normativos corregidos.
authorized_discussion_points.mandatory_qualification: Solo en el benchmark congelado; no comparar porcentajes externos.

authorized_discussion_points.allowed_statement: El piloto separa ranking, evidencia normativa y explicacion del Top-3 fijo.
authorized_discussion_points.mandatory_qualification: Diferencia funcional, sin superioridad ni exclusividad.

authorized_discussion_points.allowed_statement: Evidencia, rationale y citas tienen roles distinguibles de la auditabilidad formal.
authorized_discussion_points.mandatory_qualification: Ninguno demuestra clasificacion correcta ni legal correctness.

authorized_discussion_points.allowed_statement: La procedencia y la identidad de artefactos mejoran la inspeccion de la cadena experimental.
authorized_discussion_points.mandatory_qualification: No certifican calidad, suficiencia juridica ni correctness.

authorized_discussion_points.allowed_statement: EXP11A documenta sensibilidad conjunta a tamano y composicion.
authorized_discussion_points.mandatory_qualification: Es no causal y no aisla el efecto de tamano.

authorized_discussion_points.allowed_statement: EXP11B describe H150/H200 sobre diez pares de seeds observados.
authorized_discussion_points.mandatory_qualification: Sin inferencia a superpoblacion de seeds.

authorized_discussion_points.allowed_statement: El impacto correctivo 0B05C es dependiente del metodo.
authorized_discussion_points.mandatory_qualification: No resumir como impacto global cero ni inferir causalidad o significancia.

authorized_discussion_points.allowed_statement: El efecto de diversidad de EXP12 quedo no estimable bajo su contrato congelado.
authorized_discussion_points.mandatory_qualification: No implica inviabilidad global ni informa HE5.

forbidden_discussion_points.forbidden_statement: Afirmar superioridad numerica frente a estudios con datasets, niveles HS, metricas o protocolos no comparables.
Afirmar SOTA, mejor rendimiento de la literatura o equivalentes.
Afirmar novelty absoluta, ser el primero, unicidad o un gap definitivo no gobernado.
Atribuir a EXP11A un efecto causal de tamano.
Generalizar EXP11B a una superpoblacion de seeds.
Describir 0B05C como impacto global cero o sin impacto numerico.
Convertir EXP12 en prueba de inviabilidad matematica global.
Usar EXP12 como evidencia positiva o negativa para HE5.
Derivar exactitud global del RAG desde el rendimiento del retrieval historico.
Derivar correccion juridica desde evidencia normativa u oficialidad de la fuente.
Tratar una explicacion auditable como validacion de la clasificacion.
Atribuir leakage a antecedentes solo por ausencia de group split documentado.
Equiparar path validity, constraints o rationale con correccion legal independiente.
Equiparar provenance o reproducibilidad con auditabilidad por salida o correctness.

contribution_categories.TECHNICAL_CONTRIBUTION: Functional architecture separating historical ranking, post-ranking normative evidence and controlled explanation of a fixed Top-3.
contribution_categories.METHODOLOGICAL_CONTRIBUTION: Separated functions, DAM dependence control, bounded metrics and claims, noncausal sensitivity labels and explicit estimability boundaries.
contribution_categories.TRACEABILITY_CONTRIBUTION: Versioned result-to-claim-to-evidence bridge, limitations registry, artifact identity and documented boundaries among explanation, evidence and correctness.
